entries.title: Onyx Boox is having a back to school sale
entries.summary: You have until Aug. 23 to take advantage of BOOX's 15% off sale, which is available on their website or Amazon Store. The post Onyx Boox is having a back to school sale first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
Onyx Boox is having a back-to-school sale on a large number of its writing tablets and e-book readers. Boox is offering deals of up to 15% off. You can grab these discounts in the form of direct savings or free gifts included, and they can be purchased directly from the BOOX website or their online Amazon Store.

One of the qualifying items is this Boox Palma2 Pro e-reader for $380. The Onyx Boox Palma 2 Pro is a premium, smartphone-sized mobile ePaper reader featuring a 6.13-inch Kaleido 3 color E Ink display. This specialized screen delivers a crisp 300 PPI resolution for black-and-white text and a 150 PPI resolution for up to 4,096 colors, making it highly readable under direct sunlight. Encased in a water-repellent shell, the pocketable device weighs roughly 175 grams and integrates a dual-temperature front light system (warm and cold) alongside an ambient light sensor for automated brightness adjustments. It also supports the specialized InkSense Plus stylus for note-taking and includes a 16 MP rear camera with an LED flash that doubles as a document scanner.

The 13-inch Note Max standard bundle is available for just $630, which saves you $60 and includes the Note Max, tablet cover, and stylus tips. The Max is an ultra-slim, A4-sized digital notebook headlined by a massive 13.3-inch E Ink Carta 1300 monochrome glass display. It breaks new ground as a large-format ePaper tablet by delivering an incredibly sharp 3200 x 2400 resolution at 300 PPI, making it an ideal canvas for reviewing dense PDFs, technical documents, and sheet music. The display includes a dual-touch layer that supports finger gestures alongside the bundled BOOX Pen Plus stylus, which boasts 4,096 levels of pressure sensitivity for natural sketching and handwriting. Notably, the screen does not feature a built-in front light, meaning an external light source is required to use it in dark environments. Despite its massive screen footprint, the device maintains a premium, highly portable aesthetic, measuring just 4.6 mm thick and weighing approximately 615 grams.

One of the best deals is for the BOOX Go 10.3 Gen 2, which is $20.00 off. The Onyx Boox Go 10.3 (Gen II) series consists of two high-performance, 10.3-inch monochrome ePaper tablets running an open Android 15 operating system: the standard Go 10.3 Gen II (Classic) and the Go 10.3 Gen II Lumi. Both iterations feature a premium 10.3-inch HD glass screen utilizing an E Ink Carta 1200 display layer, pushing a highly detailed 2480 x 1860 resolution at 300 PPI. The major distinction between the variants lies in illumination: the ultra-light standard version (350 grams) drops the front light completely to deliver an entirely reflection-free, ink-on-surface outdoor reading profile. Conversely, the Lumi model (364 grams) integrates a dual-tone, color temperature-modulated (CTM) front light, providing a tailored reading experience in low-light conditions ranging from cool white to warm amber tones. Both models span just 4.8 mm thick, making them exceptionally mobile note-taking sheets.

When ordering any of these items from the BOOX site, you will also get a free TAPPY Bluetooth page-turner. The Onyx BOOX Tappy is a retro-styled, typewriter-inspired wireless Bluetooth page-turner remote. Designed with a playful “robot-like” personality featuring abstract eyes and a mouth on the casing, it allows for completely hands-free e-reader control from up to 10 meters away.

entries.title: Amazon Fire 7 Tablet available on WOOT for $24.00
entries.summary: The Amazon Fire 7 (2022 release, 12th Generation) pink version is officially called Rose. This compact, entry-level tablet is highly portable and features upgraded internals over its predecessor. The post Amazon Fire 7 Tablet available on WOOT for $24.00 first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
Woot is an online daily deals retailer founded in 2004 and acquired by Amazon in 2010. It originally offered just one discounted item per day until it sold out, but it has since expanded into multiple categories like electronics, home goods, and apparel. Today, you can purchase the Amazon Fire 7 tablet from 2022 for $24.00 for the 16GB version or $39 for the 32GB variant.

The Amazon Fire 7 (2022) features a 7-inch IPS touchscreen (1024 x 600 resolution), a 2.0 GHz quad-core processor, 2 GB of RAM, and up to 10 hours of battery life. It includes a USB-C port, a 3.5mm headphone jack, dual-band Wi-Fi, and 16GB or 32GB of expandable storage.

The Amazon Fire 7 (2022) runs on Fire OS 8, which is built on top of Android 11. This custom operating system provides a card-based home screen layout heavily tailored to Amazon’s content ecosystem, meaning users get direct, organized access to Prime Video, Kindle books, Audible, and the Amazon Appstore instead of standard Google Play services.

Fire OS 8 brings notable upgrades over older versions, including a system-wide dark theme, enhanced app permission controls (such as one-time permissions and stricter background activity limits), and a native screen recording tool. While it heavily restricts standard Google apps out of the box, the interface feels sharper and more modern while managing power usage efficiently on the tablet’s quad-core hardware.

entries.title: Minimal Phone 2 is coming out soon
entries.summary: The Minimal Phone 2 is a digital detox smartphone that is designed to stop doomscrolling. It features a physical QWERTY keyboard in a compact, premium aluminum body reminiscent of classic BlackBerry devices. The post Minimal Phone 2 is coming out soon first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
The Minimal Phone 2 by The Minimal Company is a compact, focus-driven digital detox device featuring a physical QWERTY keyboard, a premium matte aluminum body, and a smaller footprint measuring 122.6 × 72 × 9.48 mm. It is designed to minimize distractions and prevent doomscrolling.

The next-generation phone has an upgrade from the first-generation plastic shell to a matte aluminum enclosure with tight lines and rounded corners. A redesigned and modernized tactile QWERTY layout for faster, more comfortable typing. Includes a top-mounted 3.5mm headphone jack, a physical silent/kill switch, a right-side power button with an integrated fingerprint scanner, and a left-side volume rocker. The colors are available in clean silver and matte finishes. A USB-C port on the bottom edge covers charging and data, matching the connector most people already use.

The operating system is rebuilt to run faster and cut down on notifications, so the phone stays out of your way. The second-generation design is smaller and more refined than the original, making it easier to carry as a focused, single-purpose device. There is no pricing yet, but the phone is rumored to come out sometime this year.

entries.title: Libro.fm is expanding into e-books in the coming months
entries.summary: Libro.fm is partnering with Ingram for ebook distribution to secure a broad catalog from day one, including priority for self-published authors. The post Libro.fm is expanding into e-books in the coming months first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
Libro.fm has just announced that in the coming months, you’ll be able to enjoy both ebooks and audiobooks on Libro! Every purchase you make will benefit your chosen independent bookshop. They said in a statement, ” Our decision to expand into ebooks has come from years of bookseller feedback. And because of their input, we have no doubt you’ll love the addition! Since 2014, we’ve worked to create a best-in-class audiobook experience—and that’s not changing. We have an exciting roadmap ahead and can’t wait to share more in the coming months! Stay tuned for updates on our official ebook launch.”

There are going to be some excellent features when it comes to the incorporation of e-books and audiobooks. One example is LibroSync: When you have both the audiobook & ebook, you’ll be able to toggle between the two or follow the text while you listen. Credits can be used to purchase audiobooks or available ebooks. Booksellers, librarians, educators, and influencers in their various ALC programs: you can bet that this means you’ll soon have early access to ebooks as well.

“We are working to make our ebooks as accessible as possible, which includes the ability to read them on different e-readers and apps! Unfortunately, due to Amazon’s closed ecosystem, this will not include Kindle. The good news is that our apps will be a great reading experience, including our LibroSync feature to keep your audiobooks and ebook positions synced. More to come soon!”

You might not have heard about them before, but Libro.fm is a digital audiobook service that splits the profit from your purchases with a local independent bookstore of your choice. Operating as an ethical alternative to Amazon’s Audible, it functions on a similar monthly credit system while keeping money in local retail economies. Unlike many competing platforms, the audiobooks you buy on Libro.fm are free of digital rights management (DRM), meaning you truly own the files and can play them on other compatible apps and devices.

entries.title: HarperCollins is betting big on AI Audiobooks
entries.summary: Authors and industry groups have expressed concerns about automated narration replacing traditional voice talent workstreams and about the broader trend of corporate AI adoption in publishing. The post HarperCollins is betting big on AI Audiobooks first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
HarperCollins announced at an earnings call for 2026 that digital was the one silver lining, including digital audiobooks. Digital sales rose 4% for the full year and accounted for 23% of consumer revenue, down from 24% a year ago. Nonetheless, in the last three months of 2026, the company saw a 12% increase in digital sales in the fourth quarter, led by a 16% gain in audiobook sales, and is seeing gains in AI-driven narration.

“AI will certainly provide a role in helping bring books to life through the use of vivid voices and the ability to generate a compelling audio experience that makes the IP that much more valuable,” News Corp CEO Robert Thomson said in a call with analysts. “When you think about it, AI can really transform audiobooks as there will be so much more choice in the voices, the sound effects and other techniques and tools that will bring words to life.” He also touted AI’s ability to “enable much more cost-effective translations into multiple languages, both in text and audio.”

HarperCollins CEO Brian Murray elaborated on Thomson’s insights, emphasizing the company’s efforts to harness AI for translating books in foreign markets. He pointed to India as a prime example, highlighting the current absence of titles in several Indian languages. By leveraging AI for translations and narration, HarperCollins aims to address this gap. Murray mentioned that, with few exceptions, he sees no need to alter the existing English-language audiobook model that employs professional narrators.

The technology that HarperCollins is employing is the AI voices engine that they gained access to via their partnership with ElevenLabs to use synthetic text-to-speech technology for generating foreign-language and deep backlist audiobooks that otherwise would not get a human-narrated release. The publisher notes that automated tools significantly reduce production overhead and time constraints for niche catalogues.

HarperCollins maintains that human-narrated productions remain their core priority and standard, and that AI is reserved for titles lacking commercial viability for full studio recording.

Authors and industry groups have expressed concerns about automated narration replacing traditional voice talent workstreams and about the broader trend of corporate AI adoption in publishing.

entries.title: These new features are coming to the iFlytek AINOTE 2
entries.summary: iFlytek has been working hard on a big firmware update, and while it's almost ready for launch, the company has just issued a Roadmap Preview to show you what they've been building. The post These new features are coming to the iFlytek AINOTE 2 first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
The iFLYTEK AINOTE 2 is an ultra-thin, productivity-focused E-Ink paper tablet powered by built-in Large Language Models. Holding a Guinness World Record for its thinness, this device is specifically designed for professionals and students who need high-level meeting transcription, automated note organization, and document processing. The company has just released its new roadmap for the device for 2026, with upcoming software updates.

1. Note-Taking & Creation

  • Toolbar Optimizations:
    • Continuous Pen Thickness: Smooth, continuous adjustments for pen thickness across Notes, PDFs, e-books, and Office documents.
    • Flexible Floating Toolbar: Collapses into a sleek floating widget (pen, text, recording) that can be moved freely along the screen edges.
    • Top/Bottom Tab Bar: Adjust the tab bar between the top and bottom of the screen for a customized layout.
  • PDF Direct Import:
    • Insert PDFs directly into your active note (up to 50MB / 50 pages; unencrypted).
    • Use all native note editing and handwriting features on inserted PDFs seamlessly.
  • Page & Bookmark Management:
    • Multi-Select Pages: Cut, copy, paste, hide, or delete pages. Copy pages to the clipboard and paste them into other notes.
    • Categorized Bookmarks: View bookmarks sorted by Headings, Tasks, and Stars, with one-tap jumps to exact locations.
  • Audio, Transcription & AI Summaries:
    • Background Recording: Added a toggle to continue recording when the folio cover is closed (ON by default).
    • Delete Audio Only: Delete audio files independently to save space, with the ability to insert the transcript into the note body first.
    • More AI Templates: Expanded templates for meetings, lectures, videos, personal memos, and more.
    • Broader Languages: Expanded translation language picker.
  • Sharing & Exporting:
    • Added TXT format for sharing and exporting.
    • Both MP3 and TXT now support complete offline export.

2. Calendar & Tasks

  • Custom Recurrence: Tailor recurring patterns for both schedules and tasks.
  • Smart Lockscreen Widget: Displays today’s schedule by default. When today has no all-day events, all schedules have ended, and all tasks are done, it automatically switches to show tomorrow’s schedule (and updates the header to “Tomorrow’s Schedule”).

3. Reading Experience

  • Non-PDF Display Modes: Switch between General, Custom (per-book), and Classic Literature modes.
  • Layout Templates: Customize typography for an individual book and save it as a reusable template.

4. Open AI Ecosystem & Custom LLMs

  • AINOTE as your Capture Hub: AINOTE 2 serves as your primary mobile input tool. Seamlessly bridge your notes, raw ideas, and documents with mainstream AI platforms and dev environments (such as Codex, and more) for deep processing.
  • Bring Your Own API Key: Plug in your personal LLM API keys (e.g., OpenAI) to build custom automated workflows tailored to your exact productivity needs.

5. System Tweaks & Handy Features

  • Screenshot Annotations: Draw directly on screenshots with customizable pens, thickness, and erasers. Supports canvas zooming, saving, and sharing.
  • AINOTE Assistant & Support: Access the AI Assistant on the home screen/settings for quick product Q&A, view estimated feedback processing times, or copy regional support emails with one tap.
  • Wallpapers: Added full-screen signature wallpapers and clean, logo-free cloud wallpapers.
  • Third-Party Apps: Supports landscape mode, bold text, custom display settings, and long-pressing to pin apps to the top.
  • Login Upgrade: Log in quickly using email verification codes.
  • Multilingual User Guide: Added a native Japanese user guide (default for Japanese systems) with easy switching between English and Japanese.
  • Top Physical Button Customization: Customize the physical top button for quick actions (Quick AI Q&A, Instant Screenshot, Global Refresh, Go Home, New Note, or Back).

Why Join the Beta Test?

  • Early Access: Be among the very first to experience these major firmware upgrades on your AINOTE 2.
  • Direct Impact: Your firsthand feedback will be delivered directly to our R&D team for quick adjustments.
  • Exclusive Rewards: To show our gratitude, users who actively participate in the test and complete the feedback forms will stand a chance to win exclusive rewards:
    • Grand Prize (1 User): $50 Gift Card
    • Runner-Up Perks (10 Users): $10 Gift Card (Gift card options include: Amazon, Starbucks, Google Play, Apple App Store, or One4All)

🛠️ How to Participate?

We’ve made the application process super simple this time. Just add our official WhatsApp and follow the prompts to fill out the application form!

entries.title: ZecTrix Note 4 e-paper display available in September
entries.summary: A 4.2-inch AI e-paper smart note for voice tasks, reminders, clocks, images and custom templates, with Wi-Fi, BLE and a magnetic back. The post ZecTrix Note 4 e-paper display available in September first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
The ZecTrix Note 4 is a newly launched, compact 4.2-inch AI-powered smart e-paper sticky note designed as a distraction-free productivity hub. Created by ZECTRIX Lab, it functions as a “glanceable” dashboard for tasks, timers, and reminders without requiring you to look at a smartphone screen. It will be avaialble in North America in early September for $54.99.

The Note 4 features a 4.2-inch monochrome E Ink display, with a resolution of 400 × 300 pixels. It has partial refresh, sunlight-readable, and paper-like viewing. There is no front-lit display. It is powered by an ESP32-S3 processor, 16 MB of storage, and 8 MB of RAAM. WIFI and USB Type-C for charging and data. It is powered by a 2000+ mAh rechargeable battery.

Key Features and Functionality

  • AI Voice Tasks: Features a built-in microphone and speaker, enabling users to create reminders and voice-activated to-do lists by simply talking to the device.
  • Distraction-Free Productivity: Includes localized tools like a Pomodoro focus timer, weather dashboard, custom image delivery, and interactive mini-apps.
  • Magnetic Backing: Built with a magnetic backplate, allowing it to easily mount onto refrigerators, whiteboards, or metal desk frames.
  • No Screen Glow: The passive E-ink technology relies on ambient light rather than emitting harsh blue light, minimizing eye strain.

entries.title: Amazon is limiting the reviews you can read
entries.summary: If you wan to buy something on Amazon from a 3rd party seller, you will notice you can't read many reviews anymore or are limited to The post Amazon is limiting the reviews you can read first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
When buying a new book or any other product on the Amazon website, reading the reviews is a good way to determine if it is good or not. Amazon customer reviews provide product feedback from buyers. You can read feedback, check star ratings, or leave reviews yourself. Sadly, Amazon has just implemented a new policy: readers can only read five 5-star reviews; if you want to read more, you have to wait five business days to read the next batch.

There is no rhyme or reason why some users are seeing this message, while others don’t. On social media, some users have stated that they have purchase history with Amazon and do not subscribe to Amazon Prime. “I was met with a box ‘request to see more reviews, ‘ and when I clicked it got a ‘thank you, please check back in 5 business days.” Meanwhile, another user stated, “I have had my account since just after Prime was a thing, so decades now. I have purchased probably easily $100,000 of stuff; it’s not twice that, over the years. My account won’t let me read reviews either.”

Amazon Vine is an invite-only program where trusted reviewers get free items to write honest evaluations, and sellers pay fees to receive up to 30 early reviews per product. Users who are a part of this program have also run into the 5-review limit and have to ask for approval to provide more reviews.

Word has it that this has been done to stop sellers from scraping reviews and slapping them on their own product listings. Some pretty unscrupulous sellers out there will do anything to get hundreds of five-star reviews. I think it’s to combat fake reviews from review mills by summarizing 1000 purchased reviews into a single line, making them worthless to sellers. Who gets restricted appears to be random. The wait to be reinstated is to discourage everyone from just opting back in and giving the fake reviews value again. Their market research actually showed that most customers like the summaries, but they left those of us who don’t the choice with a bit of friction.

I think Amazon is trying to gravitate away from reviews that can be bought or stolen. Amazon’s market research found that most people look at the rating and AI summary and don’t read the reviews.

Update: An Amazon spokesperson confirmed that the company is trying to restrict unauthorized data scraping on its site, but it’s also mistakenly flagging legitimate customers as bots, with complaints piling up on Reddit and on Amazon’s forums.

entries.title: The Top 10 Best New Audible Audiobooks for August 2026
entries.summary: The most anticipated and highly rated new audiobooks on Audible.com feature star-studded full-cast performances, blockbuster sequels, and deep literary fiction. The post The Top 10 Best New Audible Audiobooks for August 2026 first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
The most anticipated, top-tier Audible audiobooks for August 2026 feature highly anticipated sequels, star-studded adaptations, and deeply moving literary fiction. The standout releases include Liane Moriarty’s return to her most famous universe, an immersive full-cast adaptation of an Agatha Christie classic, and powerful new narratives.

Biological War: A Scenario

Biological War: A Scenario is a terrifying, non-fiction thriller by Pulitzer Prize-winning investigative journalist Annie Jacobsen. Released on July 28, 2026, the book serves as the direct follow-up to her massive New York Times bestseller, Nuclear War: A Scenario. Rather than dealing with mushroom clouds and shockwaves, it outlines how a single, microscopic pathogen can systematically bring about the end of human civilization.

The Shampoo Effect: A Read with Jenna Pick: A Novel

The audiobook edition of The Shampoo Effect by Jenny Jackson is narrated by the award-winning voice actor Marin Ireland.

Big Little Truths: A Novel

In this highly anticipated sequel, Liane Moriarty examines the complexities of modern women’s lives, shining light on family dynamics and long-hidden truths with wit and compassion. Whether you’ve read Big Little Lies or not, this is the perfect novel for longtime fans and new readers alike.

The Unknown: A Novel

In 1926, five women disappeared from a remote island in Vermont. Now, one hundred years later, it’s happening again.

Back for Blood: Never Whistle at Night Part II

The bestselling Indigenous dark fiction anthology returns with a new selection of even more daring and sinister stories. Featuring stories of unspeakable yet satisfying terror, from twisted psychological tales to gore-filled monster hunts, this new selection of stories will sate your darkest appetites and leave you slavering for more.

The Amateur: A Novel

From the #1 New York Times bestselling author of Midwives and The Flight Attendant: When a young woman, a golf prodigy, kills a caddy with a stray ball at the country club, the investigation of this freak accident reveals a dark and shocking tale of secret affairs, predatory men, and a teenager on trial.

A Tender Age: A Novel

The book is a classic American bildungsroman (coming-of-age story) told from the perspective of an adult narrator looking back at a tumultuous year in his youth. The story follows Jeon-Gi, a ten-year-old Korean-American child of working-class immigrants. At home, he is doted on by his family, but outside, he roams a derelict neighborhood with a pack of local kids. The summer he turns eleven, his typical childhood misadventures spiral into a series of staggering events that force him onto the precipice of adult knowledge, guilt, and accountability.

Don't Be Evil: Bad Bosses, Fake Promises, and My Escape from Big Tech

Don't Be Evil: Bad Bosses, Fake Promises, and My Escape from Big Tech audiobook is narrated by the author, Claire Stapleton, and is available across major digital audio platforms. Released alongside the print edition on August 4, 2026, the unabridged audiobook runs approximately 10 hours.

Adversary to the Villain

Adversary to the Villain audiobook is narrated by Em Eldridge and was officially released on August 4, 2026. Published by Tantor Media, this unabridged fantasy romantic comedy runs 12 hours and 8 minutes. Written by TikTok sensation Hannah Nicole Maehrer, it is the fourth installment in the beloved Assistant and the Villain cozy romantasy series.

The Country Road Murders: A Thriller

The Country Road Murders: A Thriller audiobook is narrated by Emmy-nominated actor Tom Pelphrey and was officially released on July 13, 2026. Co-authored by James Patterson and Mike Lupica, this unabridged Hachette Audio production runs for 10 hours and 50 minutes. The plot follows former football star Silas Tucker as he returns to his North Carolina hometown to battle the Southern Mafia and investigate a string of disappearing teenagers.
